content: Dr. Zuhair Hallaj, a Senior Consultant on Communicable Diseases at the WHO Regional Office for the Eastern Mediterranean in Cairo, Egypt, is a leading expert in his field. Dr. Gerald T. Keusch, a Professor of International Health and Medicine at Boston University in Boston, MA, USA, contributes significantly to global health research and education. Dr. Pilar Ramos-Jimenez, affiliated with the Philippine NGO Council on Population, Health, and Welfare in Pasay City, Philippines, is a key figure in public health advocacy and policy. Professor Donald Peter McManus, a Senior Principal Research Fellow and Head of the Molecular Parasitology Laboratory at the Queensland Institute of Medical Research in Brisbane, Australia, is renowned for his work in parasitology. Dr. Eduardo Gotuzzo, Director of the Instituto de Medicina Tropical “Alexander von Humboldt” at Universidad Peruana Cayetano Heredia in Lima, Peru, is a prominent figure in tropical medicine. Dr. Kamal Kar, Chairman of the CLTS Foundation in Calcutta, India, is recognized for his innovative approaches to community-led sanitation. Dr. Ana Sanchez, an Associate Professor in the Department of Community Health Sciences at Brock University in St. Catharines, Ontario, Canada, focuses on community health and infectious diseases. Dr. Amadou Garba, Director of the Réseau International Schistosomose, Environnement, Aménagement et Lutte (RISEAL) in Niamey, Niger, is a leader in combating schistosomiasis and related diseases. Dr. Helena Ngowi, from the Department of Veterinary Medicine and Public Health at Sokoine University of Agriculture in Morogoro, Tanzania, specializes in zoonotic diseases and public health. Dr. Sarah Cleaveland, a Reader in the Division of Ecology and Evolutionary Biology at the University of Glasgow, Scotland, is an expert in the ecology of infectious diseases. Dr. Hélène Carabin, based at the University of Oklahoma Health Sciences Center in Oklahoma City, OK, USA, is a leading researcher in zoonotic diseases and public health. Professor Barbara McPake, Director and Professor at the Institute for International Health and Development at Queen Margaret University in Edinburgh, Scotland, is a prominent figure in health systems research. Dr. Margaret Gyapong, Director of the Dodowa Health Research Centre under the Ghana Health Service in Dodowa, Ghana, is a key contributor to health research in Africa. Professor Juan Arroyo Laguna, a Principal Professor in the Department of Health and Social Sciences at Universidad Peruana Cayetano Heredia in Lima, Peru, is a respected academic in public health. Professor Sarah Atkinson, a Reader in the Department of Geography at the University of Durham, England, focuses on the intersection of geography and health. Professor Rama Baru, a Professor at the Centre of Social Medicine and Community Health at Jawaharlal Nehru University in New Delhi, India, is a leading voice in social medicine. Professor Sanaa Botros, Manager of the Training and Consultation Unit at the Theodor Bilharz Research Institute in Giza, Egypt, is an expert in parasitic diseases. Dr. Mary Jane Cardosa, Director of the Institute of Health and Community Medicine at University Malaysia Sarawak, Kota, Malaysia, is a specialist in tropical diseases. Professor Simon Efange, a Professor of Chemistry at the University of Buea in Cameroon, contributes to the field of medicinal chemistry. Dr. Vish Nene, Director of the Biotechnology Thematic Group at the International Livestock Research Institute in Nairobi, Kenya, focuses on livestock health and zoonotic diseases. Dr. Antonio Oliveira-Dos-Santos, Medical Affairs Director at Genzyme in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, is involved in innovative medical therapies. Professor Paul Reider, from the Department of Chemistry at Princeton University, NJ, USA, is a distinguished chemist with contributions to drug development. Dr. Giorgio Roscigno, former CEO of the Foundation for Innovative New Diagnostics in Geneva, Switzerland, has advanced diagnostic tools for infectious diseases. Professor Anthony So, Director of the Terry Sanford Institute of Public Health Policy at Duke University, NC, USA, is a leader in health policy and innovation. Professor Ming-Wei Wang, Director of the National Centre for Drug Screening in Shanghai, China, is a pioneer in pharmaceutical research. Dr. Miguel Angel González-Block, Executive Director of the Centre for Health Systems Research at the National Institute of Public Health in Cuernavaca, Mexico, is a key figure in health systems research. Professor Olayiwola Akinsowon Erinosho, Executive Secretary at the Health Reform Foundation of Nigeria (HERFON) in Abuja, Nigeria, is a prominent advocate for health reform. Dr. Charles Collins, an Honorary Senior Research Fellow at the University of Birmingham, England, contributes to public health research. Dr. Dyna Arhin, an Associate Consultant with the Public Health Action Support Team (PHAST) at Imperial College London, England, is involved in public health initiatives. Dr. Abbas Bhuiya, Senior Social Scientist and Head of the Poverty and Health Programme at ICDDR,B in Dhaka, Bangladesh, focuses on the social determinants of health. Dr. Celia Maria de Almeida, a Senior Researcher and Professor in Health Policy and Systems Organization at ENSP/Fiocruz in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, is a leader in health policy. Professor Barun Kanjilal, a Professor at the Indian Institute of Health Management Research in Jaipur, India, specializes in health systems and policy. Dr. Joseph Kasonde, Executive Director of the Zambia Forum for Health Research in Lusaka, Zambia, is a key advocate for health research in Africa. Dr. Dorothée Kinde-Gazard, Minister of Health and head of the National AIDS Control Programme (PNLS) in Cotonou, Benin, is a leader in public health policy. Dr. Samuel Wanji, from the Research Foundation for Tropical Diseases and the Environment in Buea, Cameroon, focuses on neglected tropical diseases. Professor Anthony McMichael, a Professor at the National Centre for Epidemiology and Population Health at the Australian National University in Canberra, Australia, is a global expert in environmental health. Professor Xiao-Nong Zhou, Director of the National Institute of Parasitic Disease at the China Centers for Disease Control in Shanghai, China, is a leading parasitologist. Professor Corey Bradshaw, Director of Ecological Modelling at the University of Adelaide, Australia, specializes in the environmental impacts on health. Dr. Stuart Gillespie, Director of RENEWAL and Coordinator of the Agriculture and Health Research Platform at IFPRI, Geneva, Switzerland, integrates agriculture and health research. Dr. Suad M. Sulaiman, a Health and Environment Adviser in Khartoum, Sudan, focuses on the intersection of health and environmental issues. Professor James A. Trostle, a Professor of Anthropology at Trinity College in Hartford, CT, USA, examines the cultural dimensions of health. Dr. Jürg Utzinger, an Assistant Professor in the Department of Public Health and Epidemiology at the Swiss Tropical Institute in Basel, Switzerland, is a specialist in tropical diseases. Professor Bruce Wilcox, Director of the Global Health Program at the University of Hawaii, USA, addresses global health challenges. Dr. Guojing Yang, an Assistant Professor and Principal Investigator, contributes to research on zoonotic and helminth infections. The WHO Technical Report Series disseminates findings from international expert groups, providing the latest scientific and technical advice on a wide range of medical and public health topics. These experts serve in their personal capacities, offering independent insights that inform global health strategies.
